limitations: FinanceBench evidence text comes from PDF filings; Atlas retrieves SEC HTML, so exact span matching is not attempted. Answer presence is a lexical/numeric test.
Only 10-K questions are scored; 10-Q, 8-K and earnings-call questions are excluded with reasons rather than guessed.
No dense or reranked retriever was evaluated; no LLM judge was used.
Negatives for abstention are self-authored and labelled as such.
